title: Astranis brings Anuvu satellites online, marking debut of private GEO network
body_markdown:
#### [From SpaceNews:](https://spacenews.com/astranis-brings-anuvu-satellites-online-as-work-to-recover-utilitysat-continues/)


"TAMPA, Fla. — Two small broadband satellites for Anuvu are ready for service after reaching geostationary orbit (GEO), their manufacturer Astranis said Aug. 7, following a December launch that included four spacecraft in total..."
